title: Perception into Imagination: Executable Memory for World Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.22294v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Physical agents must use what they previously saw or touched after visibility or contact is lost. Their actions change the implications of these remembered facts. We introduce executable perceptual memory (EPM), a world-model framework that advances explicit perceptual state alongside neural latent dynamics during imagination. Its evolving read-out informs reward prediction, value estimation and policy learning. We align reward inputs with the transitions that produced them and supervise the reward head on open-loop rollouts of recorded actions. On Memory Maze $13\times13$, EPM reaches 30.37 return at 1M interactions, compared with 23.37 when the same evolving read-out informs only policy and value on a common perceptual front end: a gain of 7.00 [3.80, 10.21]. translated_title: 从感知到想象：面向世界模型的可执行记忆
translated_abstract: 物理智能体在失去视觉或接触之后，必须利用其先前看到或触摸过的信息。它们的行动会改变这些被记忆事实的含义。我们提出了可执行感知记忆（EPM），这是一种世界模型框架，在想象过程中使显式感知状态与神经潜在动态一同演化推进。其不断更新的读出信息为奖励预测、价值估计和策略学习提供依据。我们将奖励输入与产生这些奖励的状态转移对齐，并在记录动作的开环推演上对奖励头进行监督。在 Memory Maze 13×13 上，EPM 在 100 万次交互时达到 30.37 的回报，而相同的演化读出仅在共同感知前端上用于策略和价值学习时为 23.37：增益为 7.00 [3.80, 10.21]。完整方法还在 9×9 和 MiniWorld 中提升了控制性能。对记忆中视野外到达目标的探测显示，两种视觉实现中均表现出更强的奖励预期。
tldr: 提出可执行感知记忆（EPM）世界模型框架，在想象过程中同步推进显式感知状态与神经潜在动态，并将演化读出信息用于奖励预测、价值估计和策略学习，显著提升智能体在视野或接触丢失后利用过往感知信息的能力。
en_tdlr: Introduces Executable Perceptual Memory (EPM), a world-model framework that advances explicit perceptual state alongside neural latent dynamics during imagination, with its evolving read-out informing reward prediction, value estimation, and policy learning, substantially improving performance when agents must recall previously seen or touched information.
